tent.definition: A temporary shelter made from fabric and supported by poles.

sleeping-bag.definition: A warm padded bag used for sleeping outdoors.

air-mattress.definition: A soft inflatable mattress used for sleeping.

tarp.definition: A waterproof sheet placed over or beside a tent for protection.

hammock.definition: A hanging bed made from fabric or netting.

tent-pole.definition: A long support used to hold up part of a tent.

tent-peg.definition: A small pointed piece used to fasten a tent to the ground.

rain-fly.definition: A waterproof cover placed over a tent to keep out rain.

groundsheet.definition: A sheet placed under a tent to protect its floor.

pillow.definition: A soft rectangular pad that supports your head while you sleep.

campfire.definition: An outdoor fire built for warmth, cooking, or light.

firewood.definition: Pieces of dry wood used as fuel for a fire.

matches.definition: Small sticks used to make a flame.

lighter.definition: A small tool that produces a flame for lighting things.

grill.definition: A metal surface used for cooking over a fire.

camp-stove.definition: A small portable stove used for cooking outdoors.

cooler.definition: An insulated container used to keep food and drinks cold.

water-jug.definition: A large container used for carrying drinking water.

thermos.definition: A container that keeps a drink hot or cold for hours.

camping-pot.definition: A strong container used for cooking over a fire.

marshmallow.definition: A soft sweet food that becomes sticky when heated.

skewer.definition: A pointed stick used for holding food over a fire.

compass.definition: A tool used to find directions with a magnetic needle.

map.definition: A drawing that shows places, routes, and geographical features.

gps-device.definition: An electronic device that uses satellites to show a location.

headlamp.definition: A light worn on the head so both hands remain free.

lantern.definition: A portable lamp used for light while camping.

binoculars.definition: An instrument used for seeing distant objects more clearly.

whistle.definition: A small object blown to make a loud signal.

signal-mirror.definition: A reflective object used to send a signal with sunlight.

trail-marker.definition: A sign or object that marks a route or location.

backpack.definition: A bag with two shoulder straps, carried on your back.

hiking-boots.definition: Strong shoes designed for walking on rough ground.

walking-stick.definition: A stick used for support while walking.

water-bottle.definition: A container used for carrying drinking water.

pocket-knife.definition: A small folding tool with a sharp blade.

rope.definition: A strong cord used for tying or securing things.

carabiner.definition: A metal clip used to connect climbing equipment or ropes.

dry-bag.definition: A waterproof bag used to keep items dry.

first-aid-kit.definition: A collection of supplies for treating injuries.

sunscreen.definition: A cream that protects skin from the sun.

trail.definition: A path through a natural area for walking.

river.definition: A natural flow of water moving through the land.

waterfall.definition: Water falling from a high place to a lower one.

mountain.definition: A high area of land with steep slopes.

valley.definition: Low land between hills or mountains.

pine-tree.definition: A tall evergreen tree with thin needle-like leaves.

wildflower.definition: A wild flower that grows without being planted.

mushroom.definition: A living organism with a cap and stem, often found in soil.

rock.definition: A hard natural material found on the ground.

cliff.definition: A steep wall of rock or earth.

meadow.definition: An open area of grass, often surrounded by trees.

lake.definition: A large area of water surrounded by land.

hiking.definition: Walking for a long distance in the countryside.

fishing.definition: Catching fish as a sport or activity.

swimming.definition: Moving through water for exercise or pleasure.

canoeing.definition: Travelling on water in a narrow boat moved with a paddle.

bird-watching.definition: Watching birds to identify and enjoy them.

star-gazing.definition: Looking at stars in the night sky.

rock-climbing.definition: Climbing natural rock surfaces as a sport.

mountain-biking.definition: Riding a bicycle over rough outdoor paths.

hike.definition: A long walk through the countryside.

fish.definition: An animal caught with a fishing line or net.

roast-marshmallow.definition: To cook food over a fire until it is hot and browned.

star-gaze.definition: To look at stars in the night sky.

paddle.definition: A short pole with a wide blade used to move a boat.

set-up-tent.definition: To prepare and arrange a tent so it is ready to use.

explore.definition: To travel around a place to discover it.
